mainEntity.name: Does a recurring blockage mean the drain must be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not automatically. The condition and cause need assessment. Ask what the initial clearing covers and what evidence would justify further investigation or repair before approving excavation or replacement.

mainEntity.name: Is a camera inspection included in every drain-clearing job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not assume it is included. Ask whether further investigation is needed, what method is proposed and whether it is a separate scope and charge. Availability of a particular inspection method should be confirmed for the job.

mainEntity.name: Will the pipe-repair quote include wall or ceiling restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only when the written scope expressly includes it. Confirm pipe access, repair, testing and any separate restoration or other trade work rather than assuming that repairing the pipe restores every affected surface.

mainEntity.name: How do I arrange an urgent burst-pipe repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call to explain the current condition and confirm availability and charges. Keep people clear of hazards; a normal booking request is not a substitute for emergency or utility action where needed.

mainEntity.name: Why does a ceiling fan hum but not turn?

acceptedAnswer.text: A motor, control or other fan fault may be involved, but the sound alone does not identify the part. Stop using a fan behaving abnormally and arrange assessment rather than dismantling it or forcing the blades.

mainEntity.name: Can a ceiling fan be repaired or should it be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: That depends on the findings, parts availability and condition of the fan and controls. We explain the repair option and any proposed replacement before you approve the work.

mainEntity.name: Why can an online guide price differ from the written quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: A guide range describes a standard scope; the property may need different access, materials, investigation or additional work. Ask the team to identify the inclusions and approval boundaries in the written quote rather than treating an online range as a fixed offer.

mainEntity.name: Can I approve investigation without approving every possible repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Discuss the initial assessment scope and the person authorised to approve it. If further repair or replacement is proposed, ask what needs separate agreement. An enquiry or access arrangement alone is not approval of unlimited work.

mainEntity.name: What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

mainEntity.name: Can a hidden water leak cause a high bill without visible water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a concealed leak is possible without visible damage. A bill increase alone is insufficient to diagnose one. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?

acceptedAnswer.text: An RCD detects leakage imbalance; a circuit breaker responds to overload or short circuit. A combined device can do both. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: Why has my hot water suddenly stopped working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several supply, heating or plumbing faults can interrupt hot water. The system type and affected outlets guide assessment. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a running toilet and a leaking toilet base?

acceptedAnswer.text: A running cistern passes or replenishes water internally; a base leak is external water with a source that needs checking. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: Who should a tenant contact first about plumbing or electrical repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: For routine repairs, report to the agent or landlord. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency channel first. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: What is Ellis Services Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ellis Services Group is part of the Ellis Group, with a dedicated Perth repair team providing plumbing and electrical repairs and maintenance across Perth for homes, rentals, strata properties and commercial premises.

mainEntity.name: Which areas does Ellis Services Group cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our dedicated Perth repair team provides plumbing and electrical services across Perth. Include the property suburb and service required so we can prepare for the work.

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Provide the property address, affected area, factual description, when it began, whether it is active or worsening, and the best access contact. Property managers should include a work-order reference and approval pathway.

mainEntity.name: Can I send photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach exposed wiring, active sparking, wet electrical equipment or another hazard to take a photo.

mainEntity.name: What if I do not know whether the problem is plumbing or electrical?

acceptedAnswer.text: Describe what you observe rather than guessing. Our Perth team will identify the appropriate plumbing or electrical service path.

mainEntity.name: Should I use the blocked drain or blocked toilet page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Blocked Drains & Toilets for slow drainage, gurgling, backups or a blocked toilet. Use Toilet Repairs when the concern is specifically a running, leaking, slow-filling or non-functioning toilet.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if a pipe bursts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Put people and electrical safety first. If it is safe and familiar, isolate the water supply; otherwise keep clear and use the Burst Pipe Repair page to share the affected area and active water details.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if a safety switch keeps tripping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not repeatedly reset it. Note which areas lost power and what equipment was being used. Do not open the switchboard or work on fixed wiring.

mainEntity.name: How do I arrange an urgent plumbing or electrical repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0413 477 667 with the property address, current condition and access contact. The team confirms attendance and the emergency work quote; an online enquiry does not reserve a visit.

mainEntity.name: Are licence details available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Services are provided by appropriately licensed plumbing and electrical tradespeople. Current licence details are available on request for procurement or property management.

mainEntity.name: When should I call 000?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies, fire, smoke, active arcing or immediate danger. Move to a safe location first. Once the immediate hazard is made safe, contact Ellis Services Group to arrange the repair assessment.

mainEntity.name: Why can a power point stop working while other outlets still work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outlets may be on different circuits, or the fault may affect a connection or one part of a circuit. The pattern helps the investigation but does not establish the cause. Do not remove the outlet cover or repeatedly reset protection.

mainEntity.name: Is a warm or discoloured power point a safety concern?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stop using it and keep clear of visible damage, smoke or sparking. For a life-threatening emergency or fire call 000; for shock or tingling contact Western Power on 13 13 51. Arrange electrical assessment rather than continuing to use the outlet.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?

acceptedAnswer.text: An RCD detects an imbalance associated with current leaking from the intended path. A circuit breaker protects against overload or short circuit. A combined device can provide both functions; the devices are not interchangeable terms.

mainEntity.name: Does a tripping safety switch mean the switch itself is faulty?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A trip may indicate a fault in a circuit or connected equipment. The device and installation need assessment before deciding whether the switch, wiring or other equipment requires repair.

mainEntity.name: What causes water hammer in household pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: 不一定。需评估条件与原因。询问初次清除覆盖范围以及哪些证据能证明需要进一步调查或维修，才可批准挖掘或更换。

mainEntity.name: 为什么吊扇发出嗡嗡声却不转？

acceptedAnswer.text: 可能涉及电机、控制或其他风扇故障，但仅凭声音无法确定部件。停止使用异常风扇，安排评估，而不是拆解或强行转动叶片。

mainEntity.name: 吊扇可以维修还是应更换？

acceptedAnswer.text: 这取决于检查结果、零件可用性以及风扇和控制器的状况。我们在您批准工作前解释维修选项和任何建议的更换。

mainEntity.name: 漏水的洗碗机软管是管道问题还是设备维修问题？

mainEntity.name: 为什么在线指导价格会与书面报价不同？

acceptedAnswer.text: 指导范围描述的是标准范围；物业可能需要不同的接入、材料、调查或额外工作。请团队在书面报价中说明包含内容和批准边界，而不是将在线范围视为固定报价。

mainEntity.name: 我可以在不批准每个可能维修的情况下批准调查吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 讨论初步评估范围及授权批准人。如提出进一步维修或更换，请询问哪些需要单独协议。仅有查询或进入安排并不等于无限工作批准。

mainEntity.name: 您的常规工作时间和紧急安排是什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: 常规服务时间：09:00–21:00，每周七天。提供24小时紧急维修；请致电确认到场安排及紧急工作报价。紧急维修费用按报价中的工作方案收取。紧急情况请直接致电，不要仅依赖在线咨询。

mainEntity.name: 我应提供哪些信息？

acceptedAnswer.text: 请提供物业地址、受影响区域、实际情况、问题开始时间、是否仍在发生或恶化，以及进场联系人。物业经理还应提供工单编号和审批安排。

mainEntity.name: 我可以发送照片吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 照片可选：请安全拍摄后发送至 maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com。您可以在没有照片的情况下联系我们。请勿靠近裸露电线、正在冒火花的设备、潮湿电器或其他危险部位拍照。

mainEntity.name: 如果我不知道问题是管道还是电路怎么办？

acceptedAnswer.text: 请描述您观察到的情况，而非猜测。我们的珀斯团队将确定适当的管道或电路服务路径。

mainEntity.name: 我如何安排紧急管道或电路维修？

acceptedAnswer.text: 致电 0413 477 667 提供物业地址、当前状况和接触方式。团队确认到达并报价紧急工作；在线查询并不预留访问。

mainEntity.name: 许可证详情可用吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 服务由持有适当许可证的管道和电路工匠提供。当前许可证详情可根据采购或物业管理需求提供。

mainEntity.name: 我何时应拨打 000？

acceptedAnswer.text: 在生命威胁、火灾、烟雾、正在产生电弧或紧急危险时拨打 000。先移至安全地点。将紧急危险消除后，再联系 Ellis Services Group 安排维修评估。

mainEntity.name: 隐藏水泄漏会导致高账单而无明显水损吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 是的，隐藏泄漏可能没有明显损坏。账单单独上涨不足以诊断泄漏。 阅读说明。

mainEntity.name: 我的热水器突然停止工作，为什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: 多种供水、加热或管道故障可能导致热水中断。系统类型和受影响的出口将指导评估。 阅读说明。

mainEntity.name: 马桶持续流水与底座漏水有什么区别？

acceptedAnswer.text: 持续流水的水箱会在内部不断漏水或补水；马桶底座漏水则是在外部出现水迹，需要检查具体来源。 阅读说明。

mainEntity.name: 我应该使用堵塞排水还是堵塞马桶页面？

acceptedAnswer.text: 使用堵塞排水与马桶页面处理慢排水、咕噜声、堵塞或马桶堵塞。若关注的是运行、漏水、慢填充或不工作马桶，请使用马桶维修页面。

mainEntity.name: 如果管道破裂，我该怎么办？

acceptedAnswer.text: 先把人和电安全放在首位。如安全且熟悉，切断水源；否则保持安全距离并使用破裂管道维修页面分享受影响区域和活水详情。

mainEntity.name: RCD 与断路器有什么区别？

acceptedAnswer.text: RCD 检测漏电不平衡；断路器响应过载或短路。组合装置可同时完成两项功能。 阅读说明。

mainEntity.name: 如果安全开关持续跳闸，我该怎么办？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不要反复复位。记录失电区域和使用的设备。不要打开配电箱或操作固定线路。

mainEntity.name: 租户应首先联系谁处理管道或电气维修？

acceptedAnswer.text: 常规维修请向代理或房东报告。若存在紧急危险，请先使用相应的紧急渠道。 阅读说明。

mainEntity.name: Ellis Services Group 是什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: Ellis Services Group 属于 Ellis Group，拥有专门的珀斯维修团队，提供管道和电气维修与维护服务，覆盖珀斯的住宅、租赁、分层物业和商业场所。

mainEntity.name: Ellis Services Group 覆盖哪些地区？

acceptedAnswer.text: 我们的专门珀斯维修团队在珀斯提供管道和电气服务。请包含物业所在郊区和所需服务，以便我们为工作做准备。

mainEntity.name: 我应该把计量器处的水视为普通私人管道维修吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不一定。按水务公司关于计量器的指导操作，并从安全位置说明水出现的来源。供水或计量器边界很重要；不要假设每个泄漏都属于私人维护的管道。

mainEntity.name: 我应该在水管工到来前打开墙壁吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不。说明可见位置和当前状况。调查、访问和恢复应作为工作范围的一部分达成一致；自行打开饰面可能在未确定源头的情况下引入危险。

mainEntity.name: 为什么LED灯在接到调光器时会闪烁？

acceptedAnswer.text: 灯具、驱动器和调光器可能不兼容，但连接或供电问题也会导致闪烁。电工在决定需要关注哪一部分前会先评估安装。请勿拆卸灯具自行排查。

mainEntity.name: 你能在珀斯修复闪烁的LED筒灯吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 可以。我们评估受影响的照明并为约定的维修或更换报价。请告诉我们是单盏灯、一个房间还是多个电路受影响，以及调光器或大型电器是否改变症状。

mainEntity.name: 故障排查是否包括更换故障设备？

acceptedAnswer.text: 调查确定下一步建议；维修或更换可能是单独任务。报价应说明已包含的评估和任何额外工作，待您批准后再进行。

mainEntity.name: 为什么电源插座可能停止工作，而其他插座仍能工作？

acceptedAnswer.text: 插座可能在不同电路上，或故障影响连接或电路的一部分。此模式有助于调查，但并不能确定原因。请勿拆除插座盖或反复重置保护。

mainEntity.name: 温热或变色的电源插座是否存在安全隐患？

acceptedAnswer.text: 是的。请停止使用，并远离可见损坏、烟雾或冒火花。若出现危及生命的紧急情况或火灾，请拨打 000；若有电击或刺痛感，请致电 Western Power 13 13 51。请安排电气评估，而不是继续使用该插座。

mainEntity.name: RCD 与断路器有什么区别？

acceptedAnswer.text: RCD 检测到从预定路径泄漏的电流不平衡。断路器可防止过载或短路。组合装置可同时提供两种功能；这两种装置并非可互换的术语。

mainEntity.name: 跳闸的安全开关是否意味着开关本身有故障？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不。跳闸可能表示电路或连接设备存在故障。需要对设备和安装进行评估，然后决定是否需要修理开关、电线或其他设备。

mainEntity.name: 我需要请水管工还是防水专家来修理漏水的淋浴？

mainEntity.name: 家庭管道中水锤的成因是什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: 突然的水流变化会产生压力激增和敲击声。管道支撑、阀门和安装可能会产生影响。水管工会评估模式和系统，然后指定适当的工作。

mainEntity.name: 低水压可能是公共供水问题吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 是的。全屋变化可能涉及供水条件以及私人管道。请检查水务公司公告，尤其是邻居受影响时。单个慢出口是不同的调查起点。
